meta.title: Magic deck checklist: find out what your deck is missing

hero.title: Find out what your deck is missing
hero.body: Paste the list, check what you own, buy only what's missing. Card images come from Scryfall and your decks stay saved.

paste.title: Paste the list
paste.body: Takes "4 Lightning Bolt", "4x Name", set code in parentheses. Everything else is ignored.

check.title: Check what you own
check.body: One click per card. Hover to check the image before marking it.

buy.title: Buy only what's missing
buy.body: The ring shows how much is missing and the pending list is ready to go.

views.title: See it the way you like
views.body: Switch between compact rows and a grid of large cards. Try checking the cards right here.

progress.title: What's missing, at a glance
progress.body: Every deck shows a ring with the percentage left to complete it. It follows what you check above.

decks.title: All your decks in one place
decks.body: The My decks page brings it all together: commander art, colors, what each one is missing and a single shopping list for all of them.

final.title: Stop buying cards you already own
